coverage.original_callback_projection_set: all prior 12 plus the source-derived completed_without_handler_boundary case

source_consistency.pending_at_stop: accepted with ended or raised queue and with response observations because dispatch_finished is the priority boundary and stop can interleave
source_consistency.raised: requires no response; only an unhandled pre-handler dispatch requires a raised queue; raised-after-handler retains observed queue
source_consistency.completed: requires observed response; response priority permits null dispatch completion timing after dispatch error
source_consistency.returned_without_response: requires no response; observed dispatch requires observed queue and numeric dispatch return timing, while missing dispatch remains UNKNOWN/null
source_consistency.missing_boundaries: accepted only as exact UNKNOWN/null projections; no phase-presence relaxation of caps or keysets
